After a few times like that you can have more in the house but only have the certain amount from before. From there, practice drinking less still and cruise on a buzz instead of being drunk.

Once you can enjoy less alcohol and tell yourself no, then you can drink with your friends again.

If he is an alcoholic, and it sounds like he is then this will be impossible to do. Or perhaps do it for a while but it will quickly progress back to old ways.

Source: am alcoholic

If your friends cannot support you wanting to stop or reduce your drinking, then they are drinking buddies not friends.

I have a friend that decided to stop (after he drunkenly broke his leg) and I was still friends with him. Drinking wasn't the only thing we did. So when it came to a get together that had booze I made sure to always have ice cold Pepsis for him. He hasn't had a drink in years and him and I are still good friends.
I think this is very important to know. If you guys don't have a good time sober, then you're not true friends, just drinking buddies. Came to learn this the hard way, unfortunately,

Oh god, I was the same. I just don't stop drinking once I start. I had a few concussions and PTSD from my time in Iraq, and I was not a fun drinker anymore. It took getting in trouble in the Army twice, two DUIs, and waking up after trying to kill myself after a night of heavy drinking to truly realize I needed to stop. I tried the just drink two beers in social settings, but I would get too confident and eventually start drinking like I used to. I tried going to AA, but it honestly made me want to drink. I had to be sober for three weeks in the field (army), so that helped. I got back home, and it definitely killed my social life. I can't stand bars or clubs, but I go to trivia night and just drink Dr Pepper. I might be more social if I didn't hate groups of people. My advice for you: find your friends who's lives don't revolve around drinking and do activities with them. Your friends that only drink are going to want you to drink, bring your own drinks to their BBQs, let them know you've stopped, and that asshole that bugs you about being a pussy for not drinking is a turd and no one really likes him, so just tell him to go fuck himself and that you only drink on days where you haven't gotten a blow job from his mom.
